leadText:
This is the fourth chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the May 2021 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on March 19, 2021. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on CoroCoro Online on November 18, 2021 and on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on July 15, 2022.
